data.name: MCF3_001
data.value: Just kidding![pause=0] What brings you two here?

data.name: MCF3_002
data.value: Me and {0} wanted to check out the café now that it's open for business again.

data.name: MCF3_003
data.value: What are you doing here?

data.name: MCF3_004
data.value: The three of us wanted to relax before we set out on our expedition.

data.name: MCF3_005
data.value: Expedition?

data.name: MCF3_006
data.value: Yup.[pause=0] We've been planning to explore some ruins up in a far-off mountain range for some time now.

data.name: MCF3_007
data.value: Rumor has it that some amazing secret lies in the ruins there!

data.name: MCF3_008
data.value: But so far,[pause=10] nobody's been able to find anything beyond some old broken structures that don't do anything.

data.name: MCF3_009
data.value: Since {0} and I are more experienced adventurers than most,[pause=10] we figured we'd take a crack at it.

data.name: MCF3_010
data.value: Originally,[pause=10] we weren't going to leave on our expedition for a couple more weeks...

data.name: MCF3_011
data.value: ...But the Guildmaster just requested us to leave on it as soon as we could.

data.name: MCF3_012
data.value: Wow![pause=0] That's so cool![pause=0] That's the kind of adventuring I want to do!

data.name: MCF3_013
data.value: I can't wait until me and {0} can go on adventures like that!

data.name: MCF3_014
data.value: You'll get there some day![pause=0] You've got us and the rest of the guild behind you rearing for you!

data.name: MCF3_015
data.value: Good luck with your guild work until then![pause=0] {0} and I are going to be relaxing here until we leave for our trip.

data.name: MCF3_016
data.value: I'm a big fan of the drinks here,[pause=10] but {0} is a total fanatic compared to me.

data.name: MCF3_017
data.value: The taste,[pause=10] on the other hand,[pause=10] leaves something to be desired...

data.name: MCF3_018
data.value: If it's volatile,[pause=10] it'll give us an attack boost![pause=0]\nGive me it so I can carry your dead weight!

data.name: MCF3_019
data.value: He said not to drink it,[pause=10] since it's volatile...[pause=0]\nMaybe we could throw it instead of drinking it?

data.name: MCF4_001
data.value: He calls it {0}.[pause=0] He says that it helps with hanging on in tough situations.

data.name: MCF4_002
data.value: The special isn't always great,[pause=10] but sometimes he has something you won't be able to find anywhere else.

data.name: MCF4_003
data.value: It was so tasty...[pause=0] Mmmm...[pause=0] I'm drooling just thinking about it...

data.name: MCF4_004
data.value: But he hasn't sold another for some time now...[pause=0] Oh,[pause=10] woe is me...

data.name: MCF4_005
data.value: It says that while all mystery dungeons have stairs that lead forward,[pause=10] some also have stairs that lead back.

data.name: MCF4_006
data.value: The type of stairs that leads forward depends on whether it's an ascending or descending dungeon.

data.name: MCF4_007
data.value: ...That doesn't make sense though.

data.name: MCF4_008
data.value: Mystery dungeons are in places such as caves and forests as far as I understand.

data.name: MCF4_009
data.value: What would stairs be doing in the middle of a place such as that?[pause=0] Mystery dungeons truly are strange.

data.name: MCF4_010
data.value: But this is what {0} wants to do.[pause=0] And spending time with her like this is nice too...

data.name: MCF4_011
data.value: U-umm![pause=0] I m-mean...

data.name: MCF4_012
data.value: D-don't you rookies have anything better to do than laze around here?[pause=0] Go do something productive for once!

data.name: MCF4_013
data.value: Once we leave,[pause=10] it'll be a long time before we can come back to town,[pause=10] so we gotta relax while we still can!

data.name: MCF5_001
data.value: With flavor like this,[pause=10] I think he's just getting rid of his extra inventory...

data.name: MCF5_002
data.value: ...But...[pause=0] Woe is me...[pause=0] It tastes like muddy roots...

data.name: MCF5_003
data.value: ...Oh...[pause=0] Luck can be so cruel...

data.name: MCF5_004
data.value: You never know what might happen on a trip like that.[pause=0] His drinks could come in handy in a pinch.

data.name: MCF5_005
data.value: They're so tasty...[pause=0] It's important to keep your spirits up on a long journey,[pause=10] after all!
